description: Detects creation/modification of a PIP_ environment variable (index URL, find-links, config file) in the user or system Environment registry key, silently redirecting all future pip installs (Cisco Talos - pip env var abuse via PIP_<UPPER_LONG_NAME>).
references:
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/the-serpents-tongue-luring-the-python-out-of-its-den/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/14
tags:
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1112
  - attack.t1574.007
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetObject|contains: '\Environment\'
    TargetObject|endswith:
      - 'PIP_INDEX_URL'
      - 'PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL'
      - 'PIP_FIND_LINKS'
      - 'PIP_CONFIG_FILE'
      - 'PIP_TARGET'
      - 'PIP_PREFIX'
  condition: selection
level: high
2571.spl: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where (Registry.registry_path="*\\Environment*" OR Registry.registry_path="*Session Manager\\Environment*") Registry.registry_value_name IN ("PIP_INDEX_URL","PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL","PIP_FIND_LINKS","PIP_CONFIG_FILE","PIP_TARGET","PIP_PREFIX") by Registry.dest Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_name Registry.registry_value_data Registry.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2571.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 (@TargetObject:*\Environment\PIP_INDEX_URL OR @TargetObject:*\Environment\PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL OR @TargetObject:*\Environment\PIP_FIND_LINKS OR @TargetObject:*\Environment\PIP_CONFIG_FILE OR @TargetObject:*\Environment\PIP_TARGET OR @TargetObject:*\Environment\PIP_PREFIX)

| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ErrorCode == 0 and IsInteractive == false

| where Timestamp between (AuthTime .. AuthTime + AuthWindow)
| where IPAddress != AuthIP and Country != AuthCountry
| project AuthTime, ReplayTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, AuthIP, AuthCountry, ReplayIP = IPAddress, ReplayCountry = Country, Application, ResourceDisplayName, UserAgent
| order by ReplayTime desc

2647.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Misconfigured Server Reveals Three Evilginx Phishing Operations Targeting Micros
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("evilginx2.exe", "xeox-agent_x64.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("evilginx2.exe", "xeox-agent_x64.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2647.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Misconfigured Server Reveals Three Evilginx Phishing Operations Targeting Micros ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("evilginx2.exe","xeox-agent_x64.exe"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("evilginx2.exe","xeox-agent_x64.exe"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2655.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — jscrambler npm package publishes malicious preinstall binary
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("mutations.js", "queries.js", "iphlpapi.dll", "setup.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("mutations.js", "queries.js", "iphlpapi.dll", "setup.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2655.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — jscrambler npm package publishes malicious preinstall binary ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("mutations.js","queries.js","iphlpapi.dll","setup.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("mutations.js","queries.js","iphlpapi.dll","setup.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2696.sent:
let win = 10m;
let recon = ImWebSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Url has "/graphql"
    | where HttpMethod == "POST"                       // unauthenticated {meta{client_id}} probe is a POST
    | project ReconTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, ReconUrl = Url;
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Url has "/authorize"
| where Url has_any ("response_type=token", "response_type=id_token")
| project AuthTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, AuthUrl = Url, DstHostname
| join kind=inner recon on SrcIpAddr
| where AuthTime between (ReconTime .. ReconTime + win)
| project SrcIpAddr, DstHostname, ReconTime, AuthTime, DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', AuthTime, ReconTime), ReconUrl, AuthUrl
| order by AuthTime desc
2696.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Web.Web where (Web.uri_path="/graphql" OR Web.uri_path="/authorize") by _time span=1s Web.src Web.uri_path Web.uri_query Web.http_method
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| eval phase=case(uri_path=="/graphql" AND http_method=="POST","recon", uri_path=="/authorize" AND (like(uri_query,"%response_type=token%") OR like(uri_query,"%response_type=id_token%")),"exploit", true(),null())
| where isnotnull(phase)
| sort 0 src _time
| streamstats current=f last(_time) as prevTime last(phase) as prevPhase by src
| where phase=="exploit" AND prevPhase=="recon" AND (_time - prevTime) <= 600
| eval DelaySec=(_time - prevTime)
| table _time src DelaySec uri_path uri_query
